summary_1line: Ayodhya is lavishly decorated as citizens joyfully await Rama’s coronation while Rama and Sita perform prayers and fast in preparation.

image_candidates.scene_text: The streets of Ayodhya are strewn with flowers and lined with fluttering flags while crowds gather eagerly for Rama’s coronation.
Rama pours clarified butter into the sacred fire as Sita sits beside him in silent devotion within the temple.
Brahmins chant the Peace Hymn as drums resound across Ayodhya and colorful banners wave above temples and markets.
